description: This file defines the NullKeyPreviewsManager class which implements the KeyPreviewsController interface, providing empty implementations for preview management methods related to keyboard keys.

classes.name: NullKeyPreviewsManager
classes.description: A class that implements KeyPreviewsController with no-op methods for managing key previews.

methods.name: hidePreviewForKey
methods.description: Hides the preview for a specific key.

methods.name: showPreviewForKey (Drawable icon)
methods.description: Shows a preview for a key with a drawable icon.

methods.name: showPreviewForKey (CharSequence label)
methods.description: Shows a preview for a key with a label.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Performs cleanup when the preview manager is no longer needed.
